sloka: वृद्दोपसेवी लक्ष्मीवान् शक्तो न बहु भाषिता ।राजपुत्रः प्रियः श्रेष्ठः सदृशः श्वशुरस्य मे ।। ५.३८.६२।।।।
transliteration: vṛddopasevī lakṣmīvān śakto na bahu bhāṣitā ।rājaputraḥ priyaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadṛśaḥ śvaśurasya me ।। 5.38.62।।।।

translations.english: "Rama's brother Lakshmana is always dear to me. Heroic Lakshmana will discharge whichever responsibility is entrusted to him.
